front-neutral: Reviewed: frontal face, level eyes, upright neck, neutral expression, no face-touching. Identity remains recognizable.
front-smile: Reviewed: frontal face, upright neck, natural visible-teeth smile, no face-touching; distinct expression from neutral.
threequarter-left: Reviewed: torso and head turned in one direction, both eyes visible, neck supported naturally, hands away from face. Left/right label denotes composition reference, not anatomical measurement.
threequarter-right: Reviewed: opposite torso orientation from the left reference, eyes toward camera, upright posture and no face-touching.
profile-left: Reviewed: genuine left-facing profile with one eye visible, level chin, upright neck, distinctive bob and facial outline.
profile-right: Reviewed: genuine right-facing profile with one eye visible, level chin, upright neck, consistent face and bob.
standing-front: Reviewed: full body, both feet visible, relaxed arms at sides, level shoulders and vertical neck, no hand near face.
seated-upright: Reviewed: seated on stool with both hands on thighs, upright supported spine and neck, natural fingers; no cheek-on-hand pose.
walking: Reviewed: visible forward stride and arm swing, full body with feet, upright neck and natural smile; clearly different from static standing.
